template.title: Task Template Management
template.description: Templates save description, goal, category and task-level intercept/allow rules; modifying does not affect already created tasks.
template.goal_placeholder: Goal the task needs to achieve
template.category_desc: Applied when template is used (can be changed later).
template.intercept_rules_desc: Applied when template is used (intercept/allow, new tasks only, not global).
template.delete_desc: Tasks created by this template will not be affected.
template.fill_required: Please fill in template name, description and goal
template.copy_desc: After selecting, the template's description, goal, category and task-level rules will be copied, not linked to the template.
template.label: Task Template
template.use_desc: Current description and goal will be overwritten by template content.

traffic.evidence_desc: View request and response saved at bind time
traffic.preview_desc: Traffic ID: {{id}}. Full body is saved at bind time.

traffic_picker.title: Bind Traffic
traffic_picker.desc: Filter and multi-select request/response. Selected records persist across pages. After binding, you can set purpose, description and order.
traffic_picker.select_all: Select all unbound traffic on this page

retest.started: Retest started, click "Retesting" to view session
retest.in_progress: This finding is already retesting, view existing session
retest.dialog_desc: Retest Agent will read original evidence and test constraints, run targeted verification in an independent session. After successful retest and confirmed fix, finding status automatically changes to "Fixed", other conclusions remain unchanged.
retest.notes_placeholder: e.g. verify with original test account on original interface; fix version is v2.
retest.notes_desc: You can add fix version, test conditions or limitations for this retest.
retest.panel_desc: Verify current status in an independent session, keep conclusion and evidence for each retest.
retest.no_records_desc: After fix deployment, you can start retest and compare new and old evidence.

link_traffic.title: Bind to Finding
link_traffic.desc: Save {{count}} traffic as evidence for an existing finding.
link_traffic.no_match: No matching finding, please register finding first

mention.no_match: No matching records, please change name, address or ID
mention.showing_more: Showing {{count}} items, scroll down to load more
mention.search_hint: Enter name, address or ID to search records
mention.send_hint: Read latest details when sending · Max 10 items

traffic_panel.title: Associated Traffic ({{count}})
traffic_panel.desc: Organize requests and responses in reproduction order. After cleaning original traffic, bound evidence is still retained.
traffic_panel.no_traffic_desc: You can bind baseline, vulnerability proof and supplementary verification requests.
traffic_panel.edit_desc: Describe how this request/response supports the vulnerability conclusion.

llm_profile.label: Default Model (LLM Config)
llm_profile.desc: Bind fixed LLM config for this Agent (click "Save Config" to take effect). Priority: Agent binding > Task/session specified > Global active.

web_search.label: Web Search
web_search.enabled_desc: After enabling for this Agent (click save above to take effect), web_search can be used for online retrieval
web_search.disabled_desc: First enable web search in "System Settings" and configure the backend, then enable here

interactive_shell.label: Interactive Shell
interactive_shell.desc: After enabling for this Agent (click save above to take effect), persistent PTY session tools can drive msfconsole/ssh/REPL etc.

variables.label: Variables (click to insert placeholder, replaced with runtime data when rendering)

agent_editor.preview_desc: All {{var}} are replaced by backend with example values.

version.load_toast: Loaded v{{version}} into editor, click "Save as New Version" to confirm

wrapup.label: Wrap-up Prompt Body
wrapup.placeholder: Leave blank to use built-in default wrap-up prompt

wrapup_turns.label: Wrap-up turns (max rounds in wrap-up phase; 0=use built-in default {{default}} rounds)

task_timeout_wrapup.label: Task Timeout Wrap-up Prompt Body
task_timeout_wrapup.placeholder: Leave blank to use built-in default task timeout wrap-up prompt

mcp.desc: Check MCP servers visible to this Agent.

skill.desc: Check Skills visible to this Agent.

tools.desc: Check built-in tools bound to this Agent.

triggers.desc: Triggers let this custom Agent run automatically: each trigger creates a new session run (visible on "Chat" page). You can select multiple trigger conditions; the system automatically appends "why this trigger was fired + related task/finding/goal" to your base message.

strategy.label: Post-trigger handling strategy (determines how triggers are queued/merged for execution)

triggers.desc_parallel: Parallel: each trigger immediately opens a separate session for concurrent execution, no merge; triggers exceeding max concurrency queue for a slot.
triggers.desc_by_task: Serial · Merge by task: same agent runs one at a time; events for the same task in queue merge into one session.
triggers.desc_all: Serial · Merge all: same agent runs one at a time; when dequeuing, all queued triggers merge into one session.
triggers.desc_none: Serial · No merge: same agent runs one at a time; each trigger gets its own session.

add_edit.add: Add trigger (each condition can have its own user message)

triggers.interval_placeholder: Message sent to agent on scheduled trigger, e.g.: Inspect all tasks
triggers.finding_placeholder: Message sent to agent when finding discovered (system attaches task and finding details)
triggers.goal_placeholder: Message sent to agent when goal met (system attaches task and achieved goal)
triggers.timeout_placeholder: Message sent to agent on task timeout (system attaches task number and goal)
triggers.tool_call_desc: Select tools to monitor (at least one); these tools trigger every time call completes during task execution. {{count}} selected.
triggers.tool_call_placeholder: Message sent to agent when tool called (system attaches task info, tool input params and return content)
triggers.task_create_placeholder: Message sent to agent when task created (system attaches task number and goal)

toast.wrapup_saved: Wrap-up config saved (takes effect on next run)
toast.tt_wrapup_saved: Task timeout wrap-up config saved (takes effect on next run)

agent_editor.trigger_at_least_one: Select at least one trigger condition
agent_editor.trigger_tool_required: Tool call trigger requires at least one tool

side_question.title: Side Question
side_question.waiting_for_agent: Main Agent first run required before asking
side_question.ask_desc: Answer based on current Agent context, main task continues running.
side_question.independent_qa_for: Independent Q&A for {{label}} · No tool execution
side_question.clear_history_desc: Delete current Agent's side Q&A and stop generating side answers. Main session and context snapshot are retained.

code.copy_failed: Copy failed, please select content manually

context.model_review_desc: The following is the actual input snapshot sent to the review model for this review. Background is only for understanding the current action; the decision is based on the review policy.
context.model_review_old_input: This record uses old-version input, retaining the content actually sent at the time.
context.bg_old_worker: This is the Worker intent summary sent in the old version; new-version Worker review no longer sends this content.
context.no_bg_message: No background message attached to this review.
context.no_history_sent: No historical calls or execution results were sent for this review.
context.history_title: Historical calls provided to the model at the time (old version)
context.view_full_json: View full model review input JSON
context.captured_at: Session record fragment saved at {{time}}. The model actually used content is based on “Model review input”.
context.truncated_desc: Only recent context is retained, partial content has been truncated.

history.no_records: No matching historical tool execution records provided for this review.

approval.no_snapshot: This record did not save an approval detail snapshot, so the context, model initial judgment, and execution output at that time cannot be restored.

alert.digest_only: This historical record only saves the review input fingerprint, not the input original text, so the context sent to the model at that time cannot be restored. This does not mean there was no context during review; newly generated model decisions will retain input snapshots.
alert.no_input: This record did not save the model review input, possibly due to direct rule decision, exception before model call, or from an old version.

collapsible.session_audit_no_model: View session audit fragment (not sent to model)

correlation.ambiguous: There are concurrent calls with the same parameters, unable to uniquely associate the tool call; this record does not display estimated execution results.
correlation.no_unique_id: No tool call ID that can be uniquely associated has been recorded.

approval.expand_desc: Expand records to view tool requests and approval decisions, as well as the context and execution results at that time.

empty.no_match: No approval records matching filter criteria
empty.adjust_filter: Please adjust approval status or decision source, or clear filter to view all records.
empty.wait_for_decision: Records will appear here after rules or models make approval decisions.
